usage_description: RBCmd is used for parsing Recycle Bin artifacts, providing timestamps of when files were deleted by specific users. This can help in understanding user behavior or identifying potential threats.

suspicious_indicators.description: Indicates files were deleted, which may be suspicious in the context of a compromise.

known_false_positives: Normal user behavior such as accidental file deletion.
